notes: Wrapped from existing Prismata repository artifact.
Preserves source metadata for future unwrap support.

content.text:
meta:
  - udi: tooling.manifest
    name: Tooling Manifest
    category: manifest
    version: 1.0.0
primitives:
  - udi: tooling.scraper
    name: Scraper
    category: ingestion
    version: 1.0.0
    module: modules/Scraper
    capabilities:
      - scrape-folders
      - load-yaml-config
      - resolve-project-index-paths
      - render-merge-tables
      - emit-folder-trees
      - apply-mode-registry
    dependencies:
      - tooling.config-helpers
      - tooling.folder-tree
      - tooling.show-invocation-table
      - tooling.bordered-header
      - tooling.colour_key-helpers
      - tooling.configmerge
      - powershell-yaml
    notes: >
      Canonical folder scraper with config, mode registry, project-index, and
      invocation-table behavior.

  - udi: tooling.configmerge
    name: ConfigMerge
    category: merge
    version: 1.0.0
    module: modules/ConfigMerge
    capabilities:
      - deterministic-layer-merge
      - conflictmode-resolution
      - config-merge-table-rendering
      - audit-trail-merge-bookkeeping
      - registry-backed-validation
    dependencies:
      - powershell-yaml
    notes: >
      Deterministic merge engine and conflictMode precedence layer.

  - udi: tooling.sample
    name: Sample
    category: demo
    version: 0.1.0
    module: modules/Sample
    capabilities:
      - load-sample-config
      - resolve-sample-mode
      - build-merged-settings
      - demonstrate-configmerge
      - expose-module-help
    dependencies:
      - tooling.config-helpers
      - tooling.show-invocation-table
      - tooling.bordered-header
      - tooling.configmerge
      - tooling.mode-registry-helpers
      - powershell-yaml
    notes: >
      Demo module used to validate the Tooling invocation and merge pipeline.

  - udi: tooling.folder-tree
    name: FolderTree
    category: structural
    version: 0.1.0
    module: primitives/powershell/folder-tree.ps1
    capabilities:
      - traverse-folders
      - render-directory-trees
      - summarize-folders
      - filter-by-type
      - filter-by-folder
    dependencies: []
    notes: >
      Shared folder-tree renderer used by Scraper and related tooling.

  - udi: tooling.path-helpers
    name: PathHelpers
    category: path
    version: 0.1.0
    module: primitives/powershell/path-helpers.ps1
    capabilities:
      - discover-workspace-root
      - resolve-tooling-root
    dependencies: []
    notes: >
      Minimal workspace discovery helper.

  - udi: tooling.config-helpers
    name: ConfigHelpers
    category: config
    version: 0.1.0
    module: primitives/powershell/config-helpers.ps1
    capabilities:
      - convert-yaml-to-json
      - convert-json-to-yaml
      - flatten-config-objects
      - filter-missing-config-values
      - render-config-text
    dependencies:
      - powershell-yaml
    notes: >
      Config serialization and flattening helper for YAML/JSON workflows.

  - udi: tooling.colour_key-helpers
    name: ColourKeyHelpers
    category: color
    version: 0.1.0
    module: primitives/powershell/colour_key-helpers.ps1
    capabilities:
      - patch-global-colour-key
      - patch-tuilkit-rgb-dictionary
      - resolve-error-colour-spec
    dependencies:
      - Prismata/.workspace/.projects_config/GLOBAL_SHARED.d/COLOURS.json
      - tUilKit/src/tUilKit/dict/DICT_COLOURS.py
    notes: >
      Synchronizes Prismata COLOUR_KEY data with tUilKit colour definitions.

  - udi: tooling.bordered-header
    name: BorderedHeader
    category: presentation
    version: 0.1.0
    module: primitives/powershell/bordered-header.ps1
    capabilities:
      - render-borders
      - render-banner-headers
      - colorize-terminal-headers
    dependencies: []
    notes: >
      Terminal header/banner primitive used by sample and scraper scripts.

  - udi: tooling.mode-registry-helpers
    name: ModeRegistryHelpers
    category: registry
    version: 0.1.0
    module: primitives/powershell/mode-registry.helpers.ps1
    capabilities:
      - load-mode-registry
      - resolve-mode-inheritance
      - normalize-mode-records
    dependencies:
      - tooling.config-helpers
      - powershell-yaml
    notes: >
      Scraper/Sample mode registry loader and inheritance resolver.

  - udi: tooling.sample-script
    name: SampleScript
    category: demo
    version: 0.1.0
    module: primitives/powershell/sample.ps1
    capabilities:
      - print-command-invocation
      - show-config-merge-table
      - load-sample-module
      - demonstrate-default-value-table
    dependencies:
      - tooling.sample
      - tooling.config-helpers
      - tooling.show-invocation-table
      - tooling.bordered-header
      - tooling.configmerge
    notes: >
      Script entrypoint for the Sample module demo flow.

  - udi: tooling.scrape-folder
    name: ScrapeFolder
    category: ingestion
    version: 0.1.0
    module: primitives/powershell/scrape-folder.ps1
    capabilities:
      - orchestrate-scraper-runs
      - derive-include-folders-from-project-index
      - render-scraper-merge-table
      - invoke-scraper-module
    dependencies:
      - tooling.scraper
      - tooling.config-helpers
      - tooling.show-invocation-table
      - tooling.bordered-header
      - tooling.configmerge
    notes: >
      Thin orchestration script around the Scraper module.

  - udi: tooling.show-invocation-table
    name: ShowInvocationTable
    category: presentation
    version: 0.1.0
    module: primitives/powershell/show-invocation-table.ps1
    capabilities:
      - render-invocation-tables
      - emit-invocation-json
      - infer-param-metadata
      - sanitize-display-values
    dependencies:
      - tooling.sanitize-output
    notes: >
      Human/machine-friendly parameter table renderer.

  - udi: tooling.sanitize-output
    name: SanitizeOutput
    category: sanitation
    version: 0.1.0
    module: primitives/powershell/sanitize-output.ps1
    capabilities:
      - normalize-display-strings
      - strip-unicode-ellipsis
      - prepare-terminal-output
    dependencies: []
    notes: >
      Output-cleanup primitive used by invocation-table rendering.

  - udi: tooling.annotator
    name: Annotator
    category: annotation
    version: 0.1.0
    module: primitives/powershell/annotator.ps1
    capabilities:
      - annotate-directory-trees
      - capture-file-contents
      - summarize-folders
      - generate-folder-annotation-files
    dependencies: []
    notes: >
      Produces annotated folder snapshots for tooling inspection.

  - udi: tooling.border-patterns
    name: BorderPatterns
    category: rendering
    version: 0.1.0
    module: primitives/python/border_patterns.py
    capabilities:
      - provide-border-pattern-registry
      - resolve-border-style
    dependencies: []
    notes: >
      Shared border-pattern registry for the Python menu helpers.

  - udi: tooling.dialog-helpers
    name: DialogHelpers
    category: dialog
    version: 0.1.0
    module: primitives/python/dialog_helpers.py
    capabilities:
      - pick-native-file-path
      - pick-native-folder-path
      - pick-native-save-path
      - prompt-for-scan-target
    dependencies: []
    notes: >
      Cross-platform native file/folder picker helper.

  - udi: tooling.menu-helpers
    name: MenuHelpers
    category: presentation
    version: 0.1.0
    module: primitives/python/menu_helpers.py
    capabilities:
      - load-yaml-menu-registry
      - render-external-menus
      - render-action-menus
      - choose-items-with-arrows
      - safe-color-logging
    dependencies:
      - tooling.border-patterns
      - yaml
    notes: >
      Shared menu/UI helper surface used by ASTalyzer wrapper flows.

  - udi: tooling.vile
    name: VILE
    category: editor
    version: 0.1.0
    module: primitives/python/vile.py
    capabilities:
      - vi-like-multiline-editing
      - cursor-navigation
      - insert-mode-editing
      - fallback-console-editing
    dependencies:
      - tUilKit.terminal.canvas
      - tUilKit.terminal.cursor
      - msvcrt
    notes: >
      Terminal text editor primitive with optional tUilKit rendering.

  - udi: tooling.apply-menu-templates
    name: ApplyMenuTemplates
    category: automation
    version: 0.1.0
    module: generators/_archived_originals/apply_menu_templates.py
    archived: true
    capabilities:
      - discover-projects
      - detect-cli-targets
      - apply-menu-templates
      - scaffold-menu-files
    dependencies: []
    notes: >
      Repository-wide menu scaffold generator. THIS GENERATOR HAS BEEN ARCHIVED; an active deprecation stub remains at `generators/apply_menu_templates.py` and the original implementation is stored at `generators/_archived_originals/apply_menu_templates.py`.

  - udi: tooling.validate-menu-actions
    name: ValidateMenuActions
    category: automation
    version: 0.1.0
    module: generators/_archived_originals/validate_menu_actions.py
    archived: true
    capabilities:
      - collect-menu-actions-from-yaml
      - extract-actions-from-menu-actions
      - validate-action-coverage
    dependencies:
      - ast
      - yaml
    notes: >
      Validates menu action definitions against generated outputs. THIS GENERATOR HAS BEEN ARCHIVED; see `generators/_archived_originals/validate_menu_actions.py` for the original.

  - udi: tooling.replace-hardcoded-menus
    name: ReplaceHardcodedMenus
    category: automation
    version: 0.1.0
    module: generators/_archived_originals/replace_hardcoded_menus.py
    archived: true
    capabilities:
      - rewrite-hardcoded-menu-literals
      - convert-item-lists-to-code
      - patch-source-files
    dependencies:
      - re
      - shutil
      - pathlib
    notes: >
      Source-to-source rewrite helper for menu literal replacement. ARCHIVED; active stub at `generators/replace_hardcoded_menus.py`.

  - udi: tooling.apply-action-stubs
    name: ApplyActionStubs
    category: automation
    version: 0.1.0
    module: generators/_archived_originals/apply_action_stubs.py
    archived: true
    capabilities:
      - collect-yaml-actions
      - extract-actions-from-files
      - generate-stub-blocks
    dependencies: []
    notes: >
      Generates action stub blocks from menu/action sources. ARCHIVED; stub at `generators/apply_action_stubs.py` preserves migration path.

  - udi: tooling.apply-action-stubs-auto
    name: ApplyActionStubsAuto
    category: automation
    version: 0.1.0
    module: generators/_archived_originals/apply_action_stubs_auto.py
    archived: true
    capabilities:
      - run-validator
      - locate-menu-actions-files
      - sanitize-function-names
      - append-action-stubs
      - automate-stub-injection
    dependencies:
      - subprocess
      - shutil
      - json
    notes: >
      Higher-level automation wrapper around action-stub generation. ARCHIVED; see `_archived_originals` for original implementation.

  - udi: tooling.compare-menu-templates
    name: CompareMenuTemplates
    category: automation
    version: 0.1.0
    module: generators/_archived_originals/compare_menu_templates.py
    archived: true
    capabilities:
      - compare-menu-templates
      - compare-project-menu-shapes
    dependencies:
      - pathlib
    notes: >
      Lightweight diff helper for menu template comparisons. ARCHIVED; active stub available at `generators/compare_menu_templates.py`.

  - udi: tooling.menu-tree-tooling
    name: MenuTreeTooling
    category: scaffolding
    version: 0.1.0
    module: generators/_archived_originals/menu_tree_tooling.py
    archived: true
    capabilities:
      - generate-tenant-scaffolds
      - validate-tenants
      - register-tenants
      - render-tenant-menus
      - generate-boot-stubs
      - rebuild-scaffolds
    dependencies:
      - tUilKit.utils.cli_menus
      - yaml
    notes: >
      Tooling scaffold generator for tenant/menu tree workflows. ARCHIVED; new workflow uses in-repo stubs in `generators/` and original code is retained under `_archived_originals`.

  - udi: tooling.astalyzer
    name: ASTalyzer
    category: analyzer
    version: 1.0.0
    module: ASTalyzer
    capabilities:
      - parse-prompt-ast
      - normalize-prompt-ast
      - recursively-scan-python-files
      - emit-json-scan-results
      - derive-scan-udi
    dependencies:
      - tsx
      - ts-node
      - typescript
      - @types/node
    notes: >
      Analyzer core plus Python fallback scanner; version comes from package.json.

  - udi: tooling.astalyzer-wrapper
    name: ASTalyzerWrapper
    category: analyzer
    version: 1.0.0
    module: ASTalyzer/wrapper
    capabilities:
      - run-analyzer-safely
      - capture-temp-json-output
      - present-menu-driven-scan-actions
      - save-or-view-last-output
    dependencies:
      - tooling.menu-helpers
      - tooling.dialog-helpers
      - yaml
      - npx
      - tsx
    notes: >
      Interactive wrapper around ASTalyzer execution.

  - udi: tooling.universe-scaffold
    name: UniverseScaffold
    category: scaffolding
    version: 0.1.0
    module: Universe-scaffold
    capabilities:
      - load-schema
      - diff-schema
      - validate-schema
      - write-schema
      - create-field
      - rename-field
      - move-field
      - update-field
      - delete-field
    dependencies:
      - js-yaml
      - node
      - typescript
    notes: >
      Schema-editing scaffold; grouped because the core and verb files are tightly coupled.
